items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: the first trumpet player, who was Leonard Davis, he would take my part, you know.

ctx.x: Going back to when you first came to New York, was there anything like different about working in New York as opposed to where you've been before? Like, were the audiences different? Was there more pressure on the musicians?

No. But the musicians themselves were different. The New York musician, having been here, has a certain attitude, you know. For instance, like, I used to blow out my jaw like Dizzy did, you know. And I played so hard, I found that was the wrong thing for me to do, because my jaws would be all split inside.

But on the... For instance, I'll give you an example. When I first came here, I got in this band, and first of all, I never played in the band with a good string bass and a good drummer with that kind of time,…
